name: Sticky Calculator
summary: A retro and modern calculator demo for reTerminal Sticky with TI-2500 Datamath and smartphone-style calculator interfaces.
description: A retro and modern calculator demo for reTerminal Sticky with TI-2500 Datamath and smartphone-style calculator interfaces.

compatibility.notes: For Seeed Studio reTerminal Sticky with ESP32-S3 and 32MB flash.

assets.previewAlt: A retro and modern calculator demo for reTerminal Sticky with TI-2500 Datamath and smartphone-style calculator interfaces.

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Installation
notes.description: This package is a complete merged Sticky image. Use the erase option when replacing another firmware.
